messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: histogram looks different from MATLAB and GGPLOT2
parts:
That plot doesn't look like a ggplot2 graphic, and the data that you
sent doesn't have the spike around 350.

ex <- read.csv("EX1.csv")
qplot(BIN, weight = COUNT,data = ex, geom = "bar", binwidth = 1)
qplot(BIN, weight = COUNT,data = ex, geom = "bar", binwidth = 2)

There's also something clearly wrong with the underlying data, because
you have a 0 every 16-17 bins:

diff(subset(ex, COUNT == 0)$BIN)

I would recommend figuring out what's wrong with your binning
algorithm before proceeding any further.

Hadley

messages.author: 20b73f4748706290
messages.subject: Re: histogram looks different from MATLAB and GGPLOT2
parts:
I attached file and the code. The spike around 350 is an added segment.
The difference will show up when the "color="black"" is deleted.

setwd("E:/flowdata/RETCTL")
getwd()
library(ggplot2)

EX1<- read.table(file = "EX1.csv", sep = ",", header = T,na.strings=".")

P1<-ggplot(data=EX1, aes(bin, count)) +
geom_bar(stat='identity',color="black")+
#geom_segment(aes(338,0,xend = 338, yend = 200),color="grey56",size=1.2)+

opts(panel.grid.minor=theme_blank())+opts(panel.grid.major=theme_blank())+
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1600),xlim=c(0,1000))+
scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(seq(0,1000,100)))+
scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(seq(0,1600,200)))+
xlab("Channel")+
ylab(expression(bold(paste("Count"))))+
opts(axis.title.y=theme_text(angle=90,size=24,face="bold"))+
opts(axis.title.x=theme_text(size=24,vjust=-0.5,face="bold"))+
opts(axis.text.x=theme_text(size=20,face="bold"))+
opts(axis.text.y=theme_text(size=20,face="bold"))

Thank you
